title: MONAL: Model Autophagy Analysis for Modeling Human-AI Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Cross-scoring experiments and exam scenario simulations where LLMs evaluate responses generated by themselves, other models, and humans. This measures whether models assign disproportionately higher scores to their own outputs or generally favor AI-generated content over human-generated content.

Iterative 'AI-washing' experiments where text and images are repeatedly processed by generative models over multiple rounds (up to 20). The paper measures the reduction in information diversity (e.g., analyzing the density of cosine similarity scores for text) to observe how models selectively alter, preserve, or homogenize specific stylistic features and converge to a uniform style.
